summary: Every log line a webhook delivery writes, on success and on failure, now carries the request id of the event being delivered, so a failed delivery can be traced back to the request that caused it.

claims.text: Every delivery log line carries the request id.
claims.evidence: The new test passes on head and fails on base. deliver writes two log lines and both carry requestId.

sections.title: The request id in the delivery logs
sections.why: Two log calls gain a field; nothing else changes.
sections.proof: The test suite passes on head; the new test fails on base.

uncovered: Whether the log pipeline indexes requestId, so it can be searched.
